# 3D_Integration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A vertical stacking of multiple device layers with through-silicon vias (TSVs) or hybrid bonding, enabling dense inter-layer connectivity and reduced wire lengths. Enables compact, high-radix topologies in the vertical dimension, directly impacting the physical feasibility of TCC network graphs.
